page.overview:
Who is Cerilla Marodred?

Her name indicates that she was from Cairhien, given that her surname ends with the common Cairhienin ending -dred.

Cerilla held the position for twenty-two years until her death in the series. She was Ishara Nawan's successor and Igaine Luin's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Cerilla was a moderately strong Amyrlin. She negotiated the White Tower's way out of the situations in which her predecessor had enmeshed it. Her strength and influence came in large part from her ability to do that. In most other ways the Hall ran the White Tower and the Aes Sedai.

Despite Cerilla's interest and passion laying in the outside world, the Tower influence over the continent began to decline once more during her reign.
